P1.1.text: Core Lab: Leaders in Reservoir Optimization Solutions

P1.2.text: For 90 years, Core Lab has provided advanced core and fluid analysis, production optimization solutions, and expert consulting to the petroleum industry.

P1.3.text: Trusted by the World’s Leading Energy Companies for 90 Years

P1.4.text: Engineered to unlock higher reservoir connectivity, improve breakdown performance, and faster stage execution.

P1.5.text: Developing best-in-class tools to maximize results for the world’s leading energy companies.

P1.6.text: Core Predict™ – AI Analog Data Search

P1.7.text: Core Predict is an artificial intelligence tool that analyzes thin section images and searches our global rock catalog for measured petrophysical and geological analog data.

P1.8.text: Core Lab’s Saybolt team provides independent quantity and quality inspection of all types of refined products drawn from vessels, tanks, barges, and other bulk storage facilities to help with loss control.

P1.9.text: Tracer diagnostics provide operators long term, data-driven insights to optimize well spacing and enhance overall field development strategies.

P1.11.text: Field trials, lab testing, and data analytics combine to de-risk decision making, creating a statistically relevant data set in just two to three wells.

P1.12.text: Core Lab is the premiere partner for energy companies for Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) subsurface characterization.

P1.13.text: Now into its 40th year, the consortium focuses on investigating methods to optimize recovery from hydraulically fractured oil and gas wells.

P1.14.text: Core Lab has delivered innovative technologies and data-driven insights that help clients derisk decisions across complex energy environments around the world.
